top_signals.title: I watched Nvidia's Jensen Huang work the room in London. He brought big checks — and a blunt message
top_signals.summary: Nvidia has a near monopoly over the most powerful AI chips and Huang courts tech execs and world leaders with ease.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: India Frees ‘Cockroach’ Leader As Voter Row Simmers
top_signals.summary: The founder of India’s “Cockroach” protest movement was released on Saturday after being taken into police custody, his group’s legal affairs head said, as a widening fight over the country’s voter rolls keeps New Delhi on edge.
